fields.description: The response body verbatim, for debugging a mapper against what the platform actually sent rather than what we believe it sends. Append-only and pruned on the retention set in Marketing Settings — this is a debugging archive, not a data store, and it grows fast. NEVER write request headers here: an Authorization header in a doctype Sales Manager can read is a credential leak, and this app has published key material to a log before.
